package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// ComposeConfigRepoPG implements ComposeConfigRepository.
type ComposeConfigRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

// Create inserts compose config.
func (r ComposeConfigRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, cfg domain.ComposeConfig) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO compose_config (id, title, description, config, status, created_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)`,
		cfg.ID, cfg.Title, cfg.Description, cfg.Config, cfg.Status, cfg.CreatedAt)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

// GetByID returns compose config by id.
func (r ComposeConfigRepoPG) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.ComposeConfig, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, title, description, config, status, created_at FROM compose_config WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var cfg domain.ComposeConfig
	if err := row.Scan(&cfg.ID, &cfg.Title, &cfg.Description, &cfg.Config, &cfg.Status, &cfg.CreatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &cfg, nil
}

// GetByConfig returns compose config by config json.
func (r ComposeConfigRepoPG) GetByConfig(ctx context.Context, config []byte) (*domain.ComposeConfig, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, title, description, config, status, created_at FROM compose_config WHERE config=$1`, config)
	var cfg domain.ComposeConfig
	if err := row.Scan(&cfg.ID, &cfg.Title, &cfg.Description, &cfg.Config, &cfg.Status, &cfg.CreatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &cfg, nil
}

// Update updates compose config.
func (r ComposeConfigRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, cfg domain.ComposeConfig) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE compose_config SET title=$1, description=$2, config=$3, status=$4 WHERE id=$5`,
		cfg.Title, cfg.Description, cfg.Config, cfg.Status, cfg.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

// List returns compose configs with pagination.
func (r ComposeConfigRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context, filter filters.ComposeConfigFilters) ([]domain.ComposeConfig, int, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, limit, offset := filters.NormalizePagination(filter.Page, filter.Limit)

	whereClause := ""
	args := []any{}
	argIdx := 1
	if filter.Query != nil && *filter.Query != "" {
		whereClause = "WHERE (COALESCE(title,'') ILIKE $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + " OR COALESCE(description,'') ILIKE $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + ")"
		args = append(args, "%"+*filter.Query+"%")
		argIdx++
	}

	var total int
	countQuery := "SELECT count(*) FROM compose_config " + whereClause
	if err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, countQuery, args...).Scan(&total); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	query := "SELECT id, title, description, config, status, created_at FROM compose_config " + whereClause + " ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx) + " OFFSET $" + fmt.Sprint(argIdx+1)
	args = append(args, limit, offset)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var configs []domain.ComposeConfig
	for rows.Next() {
		var cfg domain.ComposeConfig
		if err := rows.Scan(&cfg.ID, &cfg.Title, &cfg.Description, &cfg.Config, &cfg.Status, &cfg.CreatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		configs = append(configs, cfg)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	return configs, total, nil
}

// Delete removes compose config by id.
func (r ComposeConfigRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM compose_config WHERE id=$1`, id)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.ComposeConfigRepository = (*ComposeConfigRepoPG)(nil)
